profile.description: Adventure Zone previously contacted Sundown Colorado / Sundown Music Festival in 2023 and 2024 using info@sundowncolorado.com and info@ignightentertainment.com. Current 2026 review found no verified active 2026 edition. Reliable public sources describe Sundown Colorado as a sober / mindfulness-focused Denver music festival created by Mike and Amber Handby through Ignight Entertainment, but later listings show the event as canceled indefinitely; a 2024 Denver Post piece only expressed hope for a revival rather than announcing a confirmed return. Do not create 2026 outreach unless the organizers officially relaunch the event.

notes.body: Gmail shows Adventure Zone outreach to Sundown Music Festival in 2023 and 2024. No reply was found. Current web research does not verify a 2026 edition. Public coverage identifies Sundown Colorado as a sober, all-ages, mindfulness/music festival created by Mike and Amber Handby, while a later event listing says it was canceled indefinitely. A 2024 Denver Post article discussed the possibility of a revival, but did not confirm one. Preserve the relationship history, but do not send new outreach unless the organizers officially relaunch Sundown.
